title: The Forge-Master's Ghost
text: The ghost of the forge-master walks the halls, hands clasped behind his back, inspecting, the way he did every morning of his life. He frowns at dust. He frowns at rust. He stops in front of the one with the heaviest gear, and he looks them up and down.

options.label: The one in the heaviest gear stands for his inspection, back straight and chin high.

outcomes.text: He grunts his approval, then reforges a piece with his cold hands.
He does not approve. With his cold hands, he shows them exactly why.

options.label: Bow to the forge-master, as his smiths once did.

outcomes.text: He nods and walks on. As he passes, he runs a cold thumb over every buckle and rivet you wear, leaving them tighter.

options.label: Tell him the forge is dead, and that he should rest.

outcomes.text: He does not take it well. No one has told him in a thousand years, and he does not believe you.
